evidence.quoted_text:
def atomic(filename, data):
    filename = Path(filename)
    durable_directory(filename.parent)
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(dir=filename.parent, delete=False) as stream:
        stream.write(data)
        stream.flush()
        os.fsync(stream.fileno())
        temporary = stream.name
    os.replace(temporary, filename)
    fsync_dir(filename.parent)
evidence.reason: The current `atomic` helper creates a `delete=False` staging file but does not remove it if writing/flushing/fsyncing or `os.replace` raises. That leaves orphan temporary files in the target directory; repeated failures can leak disk space, including in `ArtifactStore.put`. This is a routine resource-leak defect in existing intended behavior, not a new requirement. Record the staging path before the first write and unlink it on failure, while preserving the parent-directory fsync after a successful replace.
